title: 6.11 Which Bus Do I Need?
unit_outcome: Name places and transport, explain a current destination, complete a trip, follow directions, ask for help, choose a service and check its times.
goal: Use a destination to choose a service, request a ticket, board and get off at the correct stop.
grammar_function: Ana is going to the museum. Luis identifies the right bus. At the counter Ana asks for a ticket and its price; the clerk hands it over and she thanks the clerk. She boards the identified bus, hears the next stop, gets off, and completes the walk to the museum.
prerequisite: Units 1–5 and the earlier Unit 6 lessons in the displayed course sequence.
speaking_outcome: Use a destination to choose a service, request a ticket, board and get off at the correct stop.
